Hi @{author}, thanks for your interest in contributing to OpenLolo!

To keep review load manageable, this project only accepts pull requests from vouched contributors, and you are not yet on the vouched list. This pull request is closed automatically.

To get vouched:

1. Open a [Vouch Request](https://github.com/{owner}/{repo}/issues/new?template=vouch-request.yml) issue and tell us what you'd like to work on.
2. A maintainer reviews it and vouches for you by commenting on the issue.
3. Once vouched, reopen this pull request or open a new one.

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/{owner}/{repo}/blob/{default_branch}/CONTRIBUTING.md) for details.
